title: How 3D Face Unlock Works in 60 Seconds 🙂🔦 #shorts
description:
3D face unlock lights your face with invisible infrared, projects over 30,000 infrared dots, and reads how they land with an infrared camera. That becomes a 3D depth map, so a flat photo can't fool it, and a neural network compares it with your saved face. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#faceunlock #smartphone #howitworks

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: Some phones unlock by shining over *30,000* invisible dots on your face.

steps.label: Flood
steps.text: First, a *flood light* bathes your face in invisible *infrared*, so it even works in the dark.

steps.label: Dots
steps.text: Then a *dot projector* beams a pattern of thousands of infrared dots onto your face.

steps.label: Camera
steps.text: An *infrared camera* sees how the dots shift and spread over your nose, cheeks and eyes.

steps.label: Depth
steps.text: A chip turns that into a *3D depth map*, so a flat *photo* can't fool it.

steps.label: Match
steps.text: A neural network compares it with your saved face. A stranger's odds are about *one in a million*.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Light, dots, *depth*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
